title: PlayerStateSaver
description: This mod allows players to save their current state (xp, inventory, position) to a file and then load it at a later point. Made by _flushed.
body:
This mod allows you to save your in-game state, including exact position, experience level & score, inventory, including armor, offhand & nbts to a file and then load it at a later point all with configurable hotkeys.

PlayerStateSaver is the perfect mod for content creators who want to implement invisible cuts to their videos.

Files are saved in config/playerstatesaver/slot(number).json
